name: Board
description: An infinite whiteboard you and your agents build together: sticky notes, shapes, lines, frames, cards, tables, mind maps, comments and pictures.

reasons.store:read: to load your boards, and see changes as you and your agents make them
reasons.store:write: to save your boards on this computer, where agents you allow can read and change them
reasons.thread:post: to tell the chat beside the board which board you're on, and to start a message about it
reasons.agents:read: to list the agents that can work on a board, so you can chat with them
reasons.links:open: to open a link on the board in your browser when you click Open
reasons.downloads:save: to save a board you export, as a file or a picture, to your Downloads
reasons.uploads:pick: to add pictures to a board from your files, or by dropping them on it
